title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning by NWS - NewsBreak
text:
13 minutes ago Check NWS updates here
Effective: 2026-07-29 23:59:00 EDT Expires: 2026-07-30 01:00:00 EDT Urgency: Immediate Severity: Severe Certainty: Observed Instruction: Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds. Target Area: Berkeley, SC; Charleston, SC SVRCHS
The National Weather Service in Charleston has issued a
* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for portions of... Berkeley County in southeastern South Carolina... Charleston County in southeastern South Carolina...
* Until 100 AM EDT.
* At 1159 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over Charleston Naval Complex, moving southeast at 15 mph.
HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.
SOURCE...Radar indicated.
IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.
* Locations impacted include... North Charleston, Mount Pleasant, Goose Creek, Hanahan, Daniel Island, Downtown Charleston, Fort Sumter, James Island, West Ashley and Isle Of Palms.
This includes the following highways... I-26 between mile markers 214 and 221. I-526 between mile markers 15 and 17...and between mile markers 19 and 31.
